chipSemantics.outputRate: sample_rate() is configured host outputrate. Native generators tick inputclock/16 with integer accumulator; output sampled after advancing native ticks, not YMFM clock/operator division.
chipSemantics.tones: Three10bit tone periods;0/1 force constant+1, not ordinary periodic tones.0..15 attenuation uses fixed logtable with15 exactoff; latch/data bytes retain selected channel+volume/tone register betweenwrites.
chipSemantics.noise: One noise channel, periodic or white(bit0 xorbit3 feedback),16bit LFSR seeded8000, shifted on rising edge of internal divider. Rates16/32/64 or linked tone3period. Every controlwrite, including samevalue and data-only, reseeds/reloads noise.
chipSemantics.stereo: GG low4bits right/high4bits left pervoice; defaultffmono. StandaloneWorkletstereoEnabled=false enforcesSMSmono by ignoring setStereo requests.
chipSemantics.muteReset: Mute low4bits is playback setting, excluded fromserializedstate. Native clock/counters continue while muted. reset resetsphase,latches,noise andstereoFF but retainsmute.
chipSemantics.state: Rawstate serializes configuredrate/clock/accumulator, alltones,noise/stereo/divider/pendinglatch fields without pointers/padding; same-build native primitive encoding, no portable fileformat/version claim. PublicsaveState token is opaque/frozen and bound by WeakMap to samewrapperinstance; foreign/fabricated tokens reject. loadState preserves currentmute.
chipSemantics.pcmApi: Owned generateStereo returns independentcopies. reserveStereoFrames allocates without clockadvance. generateStereoView reuses borrowedcapacity-length arrays/result; onlyframes prefixvalid and latergeneration/growth/disposal invalidates data. Native growth/viewheaprefresh must remain correct. No read/status/IRQ/hooks/Into API exists.
chipSemantics.vgmLimit: Current genericVGMparser skips command4f(length2), with no PSGstereo dispatch. DirectAPI/Worklet supportsGGstereo; thismigration does not addVGM4f support.

reports.method: Actual generated JS/WASM through unchanged SegaPSG wrapper, owned and immediately consumed borrowed views, exact PCM and40-byte native state. Actual GenesisAudioEngine with real current YM2612 WASM, existing gains and real VgmPlayer save/checkpoint/seek. No mock, tolerance, Mixer or audio device.
limits: Sega PSG generates directly at its configured output rate: accumulator adds input clock, clocks the generator while >=rate*16, then samples current levels. This is not the MAME AY averaging model or a JavaScript resampler. Tone period0/1 produces constant positive output.

All8 periodic/white and fixed/tone2-linked noise modes, rising-edge LFSR, all256 Game Gear stereo masks and four independent mute groups are checked. Current VgmPlayer parses0x50 but ignores0x4f; that existing behavior is asserted without adding VGM stereo support.

Native state includes rate/clock/accumulator, oscillator/noise counters, stereo and pending command latch, but intentionally excludes mute. Raw40-byte cross-build loading is tested only for these exact trusted builds and same configuration. Public opaque snapshots remain same-instance, same-build tokens; no foreign public token is accepted.

Reset rewinds phases/latches and restores stereoFF while retaining mute. Replay explicitly restores neutral mute/gain settings before reset. Raw ABI is not fuzzed with arbitrary same-sized states; its loader checks only data pointer and size.

Borrowed arrays/result objects are reused and capacity-length. Only first requested entries are consumed immediately. Owned copies survive scratch overwrites, PCM capacity growth, real WASM memory growth and disposal. No new general guard on disposed native handles is invented.

Actual Genesis Engine uses its existing0.9 FM and0.35 PSG gains and direct frame calls. Main raw owned/borrowed partitions compare equally. Selected regular cases replay opaque state; raw bidirectional state replay is PSG-only. Engine opaque state replay includes both actual FM and PSG.

Player reset/seek fixtures exercise PSG through the actual Genesis Engine with its idle FM baseline. Active FM reset-to-power-on equality is not asserted: the existing YM2612 reset retains free-running timing. Mixed active FM+PSG is tested through opaque continuation state instead.
No Browser/Worklet scheduling, Native backend, physical hardware or listening judgement is tested.
reports.frameCountScope: Both builds: main complete body+127-frame probes; selected regular own/cross continuation bodies start at613 and have fresh127-frame probes; reset/replays have complete bodies/probes. Wrapper positives and real Player Engine generation are separate components. Source frames internal to Engine and delivered Player frames are not added twice.

coverageReview.sourceAndControls: Three tones, all attenuation levels, all eight periodic/white fixed/tone2-linked noise modes, zero/one constant-positive tone cases, continuation-byte latches and all256 Game Gear routes are exercised. Partial mute effects and phase progression are asserted for all four voices.
coverageReview.independentNoiseAndStereoPositives: A one-native-tick-per-output configuration verifies LFSR seed, counters and divider transitions at ten checkpoints per mode, including tone2 changes without immediate noise reload. Stereo expected outputs use independent channel signs and float32 table sums.
coverageReview.stateContract: All40 bytes include rate/clock/accumulator, tone/noise, stereo and pending latch. Mute is excluded and explicitly restored as a host setting. Opaque public tokens are same-instance only; raw cross-build loads are restricted to exact trusted builds/same configurations. Pointer/size rejection is checked, with no arbitrary same-size state fuzz or safety claim.
coverageReview.ownCrossAndEngineState: Raw chip own/cross continuations resume after frame613 and compare suffix PCM/probes/full native bytes/settings. Actual Genesis own-state continuations include both actual YM2612 and PSG; cross-build raw restoration is PSG-only. Active-FM reset-to-power-on equality is deliberately not claimed because existing FM reset retains free-running timing.
coverageReview.borrowedAndOwnedPcm: Borrowed arrays/result objects reuse capacity-length views and are actually overwritten. Tests retain the direct generateStereo object and verify both owned arrays survive scratch overwrite, actual PCM capacity growth, actual WASM memory growth and disposal. Only valid first-n borrowed entries are consumed immediately.
coverageReview.player: Real Genesis/VgmPlayer state/checkpoint/seek uses actual current YM2612+PSG modules and idle-FM baseline. Nine clock/rate configurations have six seek windows, positive checkpoint restores and opaque Player continuation. Existing0x4F skipping is asserted through mono routing/stateFF and equal PCM after removing those commands; no new VGM stereo support is claimed.
coverageReview.frameAccounting: Recomputed full bodies, own/cross613-frame suffixes, resets and127-frame probes agree with both reports. Independent bounded call sum is196465 per build. Player generation includes prefetch/checkpoint seek/opaque restore; delivered639348 includes only remaining prefixes and is not added again, nor are Engine delegated chip calls.
